messages:
oncall-bot: PAGER (P2) 026-11-18T02:05Z 1768211111 026 026 Tenant-specific regression detected for tenant AegisFinancial in ded-pool-9. Eval alert: tenant_cos_sim fell 15% and generation proxy quality dropped. Follow tenant-isolation runbook. Alert: <https://alerts.internal/redwood/1768211111>

leah: acked. jumping in. pulling last-night rollouts and the tenant-specific eval diffs. @sanjay any quant profile rollouts touching ded-pool-9 around 01:50 UTC?

sanjay: yea, we pushed qprofile-int4-experimental at 01:48 targeting "low-latency" tag. The rollout selector used a temporary test regex "^aeg.*test" which accidentally matched tenant_id aegis-financial because their internal alias included "aeg-test" in the metadata. That explains the isolated hit.

leah: ugh. that alias was supposed to be sanitized. quick local check: aegis_eval_small (250 prompts) shows embedding mean 0.73 vs baseline 0.89; generation proxy metrics show coherence loss ~20%. Customer support has 3 incoming tickets correlating to the window.

ops_tac: Runbook options:
- Tenant-scoped revert: unassign qprofile and pin to stable variant v4.0-fp16 for aegis-financial. Fastest, minimal risk.
- Pool rollback: revert qprofile from ded-pool-9 entirely. Broader but simpler.
Recommendation: Tenant-scoped revert + routing override.

leah: agree. Plan: 1) Pin tenant to v4.0-fp16, 2) remove experimental quant profile from tenant binding, 3) route tenant to fallback queue, 4) run canary eval subset and escalate if not restored. Support will notify customer privately.

sanjay: preparing orchestrator patch for routing override. Leah, please run tenant admin API to remove profile and add pin. I'll flip routing immediately after.

leah: executing admin call now.

leah: ```
# tenant revert + pin
POST /admin/tenants/aegis-financial/config
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "quant_profile_id": null,
  "pinned_model_variant": "v4.0-fp16",
  "pinned_until": "2026-11-18T05:00:00Z"
}
```

sanjay: applying orchestrator override for ded-pool-9 now.

sanjay: ```
PATCH /orchestrator/pools/ded-pool-9/overrides
{
  "tenant_overrides": [
    {"tenant_id": "aegis-financial", "model_variant": "v4.0-fp16", "weight": 100}
  ],
  "min_replicas_overrides": {"aegis-financial": 2}
}
```

support_kai: opening private support ticket with AegisFinancial. Message: "We're investigating a model quality regression affecting your service. We've routed you to a validated model variant while we run verification. No data exposure. ETA for initial fix ~30-40m." Asking if they want a status call.

leah: running a 200-prompt canary on the pinned variant now. results in ~9m.

oncall-bot: ACTION 026 026 Paging @marta (SEC-2 on-call) for oversight and approval to escalate to pool rollback if needed.

marta: acknowledged. If tenant revert fails we will coordinate broader rollback and customer comms. Standing by.

leah: canary results: embedding mean 0.87, generation proxy metrics within 4% of baseline. Looks restored.

support_kai: updated AegisFinancial: mitigation applied, quick validation positive; sending short timeline and logs. They requested the full RCA and a 1:1 call.

leah: mitigation validated. Next immediate steps:
- Keep pin + override for 2 hours under watch.
- Kick off extended eval (2k prompts) to run in background.
- Sanjay to remediate rollout selector logic and add tenant-allowlist/denylist to rollout API.
- Ops to open incident ticket and assign RCA owner.

sanjay: proposed fixes to rollout system:
- Remove fragility around regex/globs in production selectors. Require explicit tag selectors or an allowlist for dedicated pools.
- Add preflight dry-run that returns matched_tenants list; fail if enterprise tenants or >2 tenants matched.
- Add an "exclude_tenant_ids" param to explicitly block certain tenant IDs regardless of tags.
I'll push a PR and add a deploy checklist item to manually verify matched list for dedicated pools.

devops_jen: will also add a quick sanity check in the deployment pipeline to prevent test-only regex from being shipped to prod.

ops_tac: incident ticket INC-2026-AEGIS-21 created and assigned to ENG-DEDPOOL. Postmortem owner: @sanjay.

marta: taking over the monitoring handoff. Handoff summary:
- Root cause: experimental quant-profile qprofile-int4-experimental matched tenant via alias metadata.
- Mitigation: tenant-scoped revert + routing override to v4.0-fp16; canary validated.
- Customer notified privately; support ticket opened and 1:1 scheduled.
- Next: rollout API hardening, pipeline sanity checks, alert tuning (lower thresh for enterprise tenants).

marta: I'll update incident ticket in 2h or sooner if anything changes. Ping me for urgent regressions. :thumbsup:

leah: attaching CLI logs, canary diffs, and the admin command history to INC-2026-AEGIS-21. handing off to @marta.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED 026 026 Quality restored for AegisFinancial. Monitoring window: 2h. Incident ticket: <https://incidents.internal/redwood/INC-2026-AEGIS-21>

support_kai: sending final customer update with timeline and RCA invite. Thanks team.

marta: closing this Slack thread from on-call perspective; leaving the incident ticket open for the RCA. Good job everyone.
